body: Use case stylized-concept. Production game CUTOUT CHARACTER sprite atlas on transparent background. Clean cel shaded hand-painted 2D fantasy, crisp dark contours and readable shapes. Subject Fast slender masked forest Rogue in slate blue charcoal leather, close hood, narrow bright eyes, burgundy neck scarf, short split dark cape, fitted dark trousers, soft boots. No weapons on body sheet. Exact tall atlas layout: SIX columns, TWELVE rows, 72 isolated pieces total. Each column is a real different direction: E right side, SE front right three-quarter, SW front left three-quarter, W left side, NW back left three-quarter, NE back right three-quarter. Each row exactly one anatomical piece, order top to bottom: HEAD, TORSO WITHOUT HEAD OR ARMS, detached CAPE, PELVIS belt-and-hips, LEFT UPPER ARM, RIGHT UPPER ARM, LEFT FOREARM WITH HAND, RIGHT FOREARM WITH HAND, LEFT LEG WITHOUT BOOT, RIGHT LEG WITHOUT BOOT, LEFT BOOT, RIGHT BOOT. Flat neutral straight poses. Every piece separate with generous alpha-zero gaps. No assembled character, no weapons, no duplicated head on torso, no labels, no grid, no background, no shadows. 1024x1536 portrait. Six genuine rotated views, consistent anatomy and clothing.
equipment: Use case stylized-concept. Production transparent 2D fantasy equipment sprite atlas for rogue. Clean cel shaded painted fantasy with crisp ink contours. TWO rows of six items. Row1: short silver steel dagger with worn brown wrapped hilt. Row2: burgundy fabric neck scarf with a trailing loose end. Each column rotates equipment to match E,SE,SW,W,NW,NE. Exact12 isolated pieces. Six equally spaced columns, generous margins, detached objects only, no hands or characters, no text, no grid, no background haze. Landscape1536x1024. All pieces clean alpha transparent.
effects: Use case stylized-concept. Production 2D game VFX sheet for forest rogue, clean cel shaded fantasy style, fully transparent background. Exact6columns4rows grid, 24separateframes, no text or grid lines. Four rows six frames: row1 quick thin silver dagger slash arc; row2 small neutral ivory impact sparks; row3 short smoky arrival puff slate-blue; row4 small green leaf footstep trail. Every row is six successive animationframes expanding/animating then fading. Keep each within its cell, generous transparent margins. No opaque background, no fullcanvasglow. Landscape1536x1024.
